ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure marks the locations of four cities, including Copenhagen, Beijing, and Singapore in the left figure, and Rio de Janeiro in the right figure. The figure has a latitude line marked “0°”, which can be used as a reference for the equator’s position; Singapore’s location is closest to the 0° latitude line, Beijing and Copenhagen are north of the equator and at higher latitudes, and Rio de Janeiro is south of the equator and is also farther from the equator than Singapore. Reasoning: The event date is March 23, 2013, close to the vernal equinox, and the latitude δ of the direct solar point is about 0°. Noon solar altitude can be compared by the formula H = 90° - |φ - δ|, that is, the closer a city’s latitude φ is to the latitude of the direct solar point, the greater the noon solar altitude. Since δ is about 0°, among the four cities, Singapore, which is closest to the equator, has the smallest |φ - δ|, so the city with the greatest noon solar altitude is Singapore.

method.method_draft: 从题干日期确定3月23日接近春分，太阳直射点纬度约为0°。再从图中四城市位置读出各自与赤道的距离：新加坡最靠近0°纬线，其余城市离赤道更远。代入或比较 H=90°-|φ-δ|，新加坡的 |φ-δ| 最小，所以活动当天正午太阳高度最大的是新加坡。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中标出了四个城市的位置，分别包括左图中的哥本哈根、北京、新加坡，以及右图中的里约热内卢。图中有标注“0°”的纬线，可作为赤道位置参考；新加坡的位置最接近0°纬线，北京和哥本哈根位于赤道以北且纬度更高，里约热内卢位于赤道以南，也比新加坡离赤道远。

推理：活动日期为2013年3月23日，接近春分日，太阳直射点纬度δ约为0°。正午太阳高度可比较公式 H = 90° - |φ - δ|，即某城市纬度φ越接近太阳直射点纬度，正午太阳高度越大。由于δ约为0°，四城市中最接近赤道的新加坡的 |φ - δ| 最小，所以正午太阳高度最大的是新加坡。
